{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# First, check which rows have commas in revenue
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of rows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Clean the revenue column
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}")

# Return the value for the answer
mean_revenue"}
